status: Definitions frozen for initial implementation; measurements unrun

reference.minimum: native desktop, four modern CPU cores, 16 GiB RAM, SSD
reference.owner: Project owner waived agent-run native validation project-wide and will test work packages on their own machine. Cloud results remain labeled as cloud measurements.

workload_contract.topology: Two settlements share cohort/time budgets across overlapping watershed/jurisdiction scopes. Repeat finite resource/service chains; include policy conflicts, a declared linear SCC and explicit unsupported SCC, local delivery bottlenecks and group access. Scale by stable namespaced fixture IDs, not copied spendable stock.
workload_contract.dynamic: 365 integer days, daily service/allocation and stock loss, weekly finite delivery, seasonal input, annual cohort/service update, dated disjoint/conflicting policy adoptions, deterministic disruption/repair claims. Every supported boundary executes; stochastic throughput measured separately.
workload_contract.history: One root and 20 named branches referencing 1000 immutable revisions; 100000 trace nodes share explanatory dependencies; bounded pages never load the whole graph into one response.
workload_contract.independent_oracle: WP-019-fixtures freezes exact coefficients, yields, account quantum, SCC matrices, event schedule, pack/model/runtime IDs and content digests before measurement. Hand-derived exact totals and replay digests precede optimization. No trivial disconnected workload can certify this contract.
workload_contract.generation: Deterministic stable-ID generator, no network or actual user data. WP-019-fixtures implements fixture bytes and retains digests; currently no executable workload exists.

measurement.percentile: nearest-rank p95 at sorted sample ceil(0.95*n); raw durations retained
measurement.clock: monotonic high-resolution process timer; label renderer interaction, main IPC and engine compute separately
measurement.memory: sample combined main/renderer/engine resident-set peak over workload; retain sampling interval and process identities
measurement.exclusions: Network/provider generation latency reported separately, never subtracted from a local engine failure. Large/stochastic throughput reported separately. Solver-specific budget/status fixed with selected component.
measurement.rebaseline: Record DEC-06 amendment, reason, old/new budgets and forecast impact before accepting changed scope; no silent waiver after failing a run.
